name: MULLE
description: Mulle (also known as Swedish Casino or Nordic Casino) is a fishing card game popular in Sweden and Finland. It is a variant of the international Casino game family, where players capture cards from a central layout by matching values. The game features unique Nordic scoring rules and special values for certain cards.

content.text: Mulle (also known as Swedish Casino or Nordic Casino) is a fishing card game popular in Sweden and Finland. It is a variant of the international Casino game family, where players capture cards from a central layout by matching values. The game features unique Nordic scoring rules and special values for certain cards.
Mulle is part of the Casino game family that spread throughout the world. The Nordic variant developed specific rules for scoring and card values, distinguishing it from other national variants.
Standard 52-card deck. Cards have numerical capture values: 2-10 = face value, Jack = 11, Queen = 12, King = 13, Ace = 1 or 14 (player's choice).
4 cards to each player and 4 cards face-up to the table. Remaining cards form the stock.

items.text: Krypkasino: Negative version where the aim is to avoid capturing scoring cards.
Royal Casino: Variant with face cards having numerical values for capturing.
